blocks.x: Talent, Skills & Workforce Intelligence: the composed architecture, the platforms underneath and the metric the program is judged on.
The problem this solution exists for
Skills live in resumes and manager heads; workforce planning is headcount arithmetic; internal mobility blocked by invisible skills; learning spend unmeasured.
Our approach
We build the skills graph: HRIS/LMS/performance data unified to a taxonomy, role/skill gap analytics feeding hiring and mobility, learning pathways wired to gaps, and evidence of capability transfer.
Components

items: Role/current-state gaps by unit and future need

blocks.x: Platform stack
The solution runs on Dataq Nexus and Dataq Compass: Enterprise decisions in milliseconds — with a full evidence trail for each decision. Model governance your risk committee and regulator can review.
How it runs in an engagement

items: Baseline metrics for this problem locked with owners; current-state decision/data flow mapped in two weeks.
Gated pilot on bounded scope with the testable criterion agreed by finance before the first build sprint.
Staged rollout on the platform stack with SLOs, replay evidence and operator enablement.
Challenger models and policies quarterly; conformance monitoring; annual value audit against baseline.

blocks.x: Prerequisites and data readiness

The readiness checklist covers three items: source-system access under your security policy, an operating team willing to trial the new workflow, and agreement on the baseline measurement method before work starts.

blocks.x: Industry fit

Deployed across Technology & SaaS, Banking & Financial Services, Education & Research, Healthcare & Life Sciences. Each industry play adjusts the regulatory frame, the integration surface and the KPI set — the pattern stays, the physics changes.
Outcomes we commit to
How a delivery runs

Delivery follows the same weekly rhythm on every program of this type. Weeks 1–2 lock the baseline: the current metric is measured with your team and signed before build starts. Weeks 3–8 deliver the pilot on bounded scope — one decision path, one workflow, one plant or one portfolio — with a control owner named on your side. Weeks 9–12 industrialize what worked: runbooks, monitoring, enablement and a measured delta against the signed baseline. Anything that misses its gate is stopped or redirected with a documented decision, not quietly extended.
